summary: Keep slow ownership-lock initialization outside the process-wide registry mutex

rules.detail: Ownership checks and filesystem flock exclusion are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Slow lock-file opens no longer block cached async admission for unrelated driver paths. Racing synchronous initializers recheck the registry and retain a single shared descriptor and admission entry.

downtime.detail: Normal binary rollout; no live-state changes.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback; filesystem lock protocol is unchanged.
